cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Can you tell me the winning cake temperature without becoming my co-baker?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want my secret recipe too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Only the degree at which my original idea should happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the temperature quietly so my achievement can concentrate.
